name: fluxonium (superinductance and junction), classical phase particle
question: Does a flux sweep of the fluxonium remove a well (threshold write) and which states coexist?
assumptions: U = E_L (phi - phi_e)^2/2 - E_J cos(phi) with ell = E_L/E_J = 0.06 (heavy fluxonium E_L/h = 0.24 GHz, E_J/h = 8.11 GHz, Gyenis)
